learning_outcomes.description: Know the Types of Pipes and its Application in Plumbing.

performance_criteria.description: Explain various types of pipe used in plumbing.
Describe plumbing signs and symbol.
State 3 types of pipes that can be used in cold and hot water supply and their application
Identify fittings that match various types of pipes mentioned in 1.3 above.
Select fittings that match various types of pipes identified.
Perform connection of 2 pipes and fittings identified.

learning_outcomes.description: Demonstrate the Use of basic tools and equipment required for simple tasks.

performance_criteria.description: Identify tools and equipment for plumbing installation.
Select tools, equipment and materials that can be used for installation of wash hand basin and water closet.
Apply the appropriate tools and equipment to perform the WC and wash hand basin installation.
Use appropriate tools and equipment in accordance with health and safety.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand basic water supply and distribution

performance_criteria.description: Identify sources of water supply.
Sketch water supply at a height of a bungalow building. Show by sketch the method of connecting water supply from overhead tank
Differentiate between direct and indirect water supply by sketching
Differentiate between clean and contaminated water.
Identify and explain what can render water impure.
Perform cleaning process of overhead tank.
Identify the simple procedures for loading and offloading of plumbing materials in line with environmental health and safety requirement.
Carry out lift and shift operations in accordance with workplace environmental health and safety requirement.
Carry out proper storing and stacking of tools and materials.
Observe individual work and teamwork for lifting, loading and offloading of materials.

learning_outcomes.description: Use the Procedures and process of storage and stacking of tools.

performance_criteria.description: Use material storage method last in first out (LIFO) and first in last out (FILO).
Load and offload materials such as pipes and fittings.
Use the procedure of storing and stacking of inflammables construction materials
Carryout maintenance requirements of tools and equipment.
Apply safety rules for material storage.
Use safe access to storage areas.
Checks for safe storage conditions with up-to-date records.

units.title: CUTTTING, THREADING AND COUPLING OF PIPES

performance_criteria.description: Identify the different cutting tools for pipe cutting.
Select the cutting tool use for cutting light gauge copper, PVC and PPR Pipes.
Explain at least 3 importance of using pipe cutting tools.
Use cutting tools to cut out PVC, PPR and Light gauge copper pipes.
Identify 3 types of pipes that can be threaded
Select the right size of dies for threading pipes of w.c and bath supply
Perform basic threading on the following PVC pipes, ½” and 1”
Explain the importance of using the right size of dies for cutting threads.
Couple the threaded pipes to form a simple network.

learning_outcomes.description: Demonstrate Coupling Mild Steel, Light gauge copper and PVC Pipes.

performance_criteria.description: Explain joint in mild steel, light gauge copper and pvc/plastic pipes.
State tools and materials required for mild steel coupling.
Identify 3 different types of mild steel i.e screwed joint, flanged joint and welded joint.
Carry out the 3 types of joints used in mild steel.
Enumerate tools and materials required for joints in light gauge copper pipes.
Identify 4 different types of joints in light gauge copper pipes i.e Manipulator Compression joint, Non Manipulator Compression joint, Capillary joint and Self formed socket joint.
Carry out the four types of joints in light gauge copper pipes in line with safety precautions.
Explain joints in plastic pipes (PVC)
Identify different types of joints in plastic pipes i.e push fit joint, solvent cement joint and compression joint
Carry out 3 types of joints on plastic pipe (PVC) in line with safety precaution.

learning_outcomes.description: Demonstrate method of Bending mild steel pipe in plumbing work

performance_criteria.description: Explain bending of plumbing pipe
Describe machine bending of mild steel and G.I pipes in plumbing work
Enumerate 6 types of tools used in mild steel bending of plumbing pipes.
Sketch a working drawing or template for making 90’ bend
Follow the operational steps and make a 90’ bend of galvanize or mild steel pipe with hydraulic bending machine

learning_outcomes.description: Demonstrate method of bending light gauge copper pipe in plumbing work

performance_criteria.description: Explain light gauge copper pipe machine bending
Describe floor mounted bending machine to make a 90’ light
Enumerate 6 types tools used in light gauge copper pipe machine
BendSketch a working drawing or template for making the center of the bend
Use the operational steps and make a 90’ light gauge copper pipe bend with floor mounted copper machine.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand Heat bending to mild steel, light gauge copper and plastic pipes in plumbing

performance_criteria.description: Explain heat bending of pipes in plumbing work
Demonstrate 3 different types of heat bending applicable on plumbing pipes.
Enumerate specific tools used in heat bending of plumbing pipes.
Use the operational steps involved in heat bending method to make a 90’ bend on mild steel, light gauge copper and plastic

learning_outcomes.description: Spring bending for light gauge copper, lead and plastic pipes

performance_criteria.description: Explain spring bending for light gauge copper, lead and plastic pipes
State two different types of bending spring of plumbing pipes i.e internal and external springs.
Explain simple jig and hot air jet method of plumbing pipes bending.
Enumerate 6 tools required for spring bending for light gauge copper, lead and plastic pipes i.e Blow lamps, Tung, Tri-square, Jig for bending of pipe, pipe reamer.
Sketch working drawing or template for marking the heat length for a 90’ bend from the working drawing.
Use the step by step process of working out the heat length for a 90’ bends on a piece of 25mm diameter plastic pipe.
